dish: Judd mat Gaardebounen; 800°-fired matured beef; bouchée à la reine
address: Sofitel Luxembourg Europe, 6 rue du Fort Niedergrünewald, L-2226 Luxembourg (Kirchberg), Luxembourg
w: Top-flight Luxembourgish cooking by executive chef Yann Castano in the atrium of the Sofitel Europe on Kirchberg — matured meats fired at 800°, Schankenmark (marrow bone) and a generous bouchée à la reine, built on short local supply chains.

dish: Italian tasting menu (fresh pasta; seasonal fine dining)
w: Chef Roberto Fani earned a Michelin star in Italy before opening this cosy, stylish room in the country town of Roeser — seamless service, a first-rate sommelier and one of the Grand Duchy's twelve starred tables.

dish: Cuvée 1921 Crémant de Luxembourg (méthode traditionnelle)
address: 8 Rue du Pont, L-6773 Grevenmacher, Luxembourg
w: Luxembourg's emblematic sparkling-wine house on the Moselle at Grevenmacher, now in its fifth generation and producing ~3.5 million bottles of traditional-method crémant a year; a guided cellar visit and tasting (from €8) ends with Moselle views.

dish: Wormeldange Koeppchen Riesling 'Les Terrasses'; Crémant Grande Cuvée
w: One of the Luxembourg Moselle's most prestigious signatures, founded 1875 on the banks of the river at Wormeldange — a reference for steep-slope Koeppchen Riesling and elegant crémants (its 'Les Terrasses' was named best European Riesling by Meiningers' Best of Riesling).

dish: game terrine; brasserie grills; salmon with choucroute
w: A sprawling chalet with a wood-burning fire and waterside terrace in the far north at Huldange, holding one of only three Michelin Bib Gourmands in the country — gutsy, textbook Gallic brasserie fare (game terrine, salmon with choucroute) cooked generously and to order.

dish: northern terroir dishes cooked with local Ourdaller beer
w: A renovated Ardennes farmhouse at Heinerscheid near the German border celebrating the far north's terroir — traced, short-circuit produce, dishes braised in beer and its own on-site micro-brewery (Ourdaller amber/blond, Hengeschter).

dish: terroir tasting menu of local Luxembourg produce
w: Chef Killian Crowley's terroir-driven table at Wiltz, named Gault&Millau Luxembourg 'Meilleur restaurant de terroir 2024' (13.5/20) — a short menu built almost entirely on Luxembourg producers.

dish: homemade pasta & Neapolitan polpette
address: 5 Rue Louvigny, L-1946 Luxembourg (Ville Haute), Luxembourg
w: Opened in 1950 as Luxembourg's very first Italian restaurant and still going on rue Louvigny under Venetian chandeliers — homemade pasta, timeless hospitality and a gastronomic menu that turns with the season.

dish: everything-homemade pasta from the open kitchen
w: A Gault&Millau-listed trattoria where everything is homemade in the open kitchen and a short daily specials board keeps the quality high — the lively, no-frills counterpoint to the city's fine-dining Italians.

dish: seasonal French gastronomy
address: 8 Rue Xavier Brasseur, L-4040 Esch-sur-Alzette, Luxembourg
w: A long-running Gault&Millau gastronomic address in central Esch-sur-Alzette, the second city's benchmark for refined seasonal French cooking.

dish: classic French gastronomic menu
address: 138 Boulevard J.-F. Kennedy, L-4171 Esch-sur-Alzette (Belval), Luxembourg
w: A Gault&Millau-rated gastronomic French kitchen on Belval's boulevard Kennedy in Esch-sur-Alzette — polished plates in the redeveloped steel-town quarter.

dish: creative market-driven bistro plates
address: 10 Avenue du Rock'n'Roll, L-4361 Esch-sur-Alzette (Belval), Luxembourg
w: A Gault&Millau 'POP' pick on Belval's avenue du Rock'n'Roll — the guide's badge for a lively, creative, good-value venue in Esch's university-and-culture district.

dish: French-Luxembourg gastronomy in the Mullerthal
w: A Gault&Millau-rated table at Grundhof in the Mullerthal ('Little Switzerland'), working regional produce into a French-Luxembourg gastronomic menu at the mouth of the valley walks.

dish: seasonal Luxembourg-French cuisine
w: A village table at Berdorf in the heart of the Mullerthal, Gault&Millau-listed for seasonal Luxembourg-French cooking made for walkers exploring Petite Suisse.

dish: seasonal French gastronomic menu
address: Hôtel Bel Air, Route de Berdorf, Echternach, Luxembourg
w: The gastronomic restaurant of the Hotel Bel Air above Echternach, Gault&Millau-rated (13/20) for a seasonal French menu overlooking the Sûre valley near Luxembourg's oldest town.

dish: Luxembourgish specialities paired with Moselle wine
w: A Dudelange address featured in the Gault&Millau Luxembourg guide — a wine-stube pairing hearty Luxembourgish plates with the Grand Duchy's own Moselle bottles in the southern steel town.

dish: seasonal gastronomic menu in the castle town
w: A Gault&Millau-listed seasonal gastronomic stop in refined surroundings beside the castle at Clervaux, gateway to the Family of Man exhibition and the northern Ösling.

dish: fire-grilled dry-aged Aubrac beef; local cheese croquettes
w: A Gault&Millau-listed inn near Vianden in the Ösling, known for dry-aged Aubrac beef grilled over fire, tender spare ribs and local cheese croquettes — traditional cooking with a lighter, contemporary touch.

dish: organic Crémant de Luxembourg; Remerschen Hiischebierg Riesling
address: 6 Rue des Prés, L-5441 Remerschen (Schengen), Luxembourg
w: A 9-hectare family estate at Remerschen near Schengen, founded 1872 and certified organic since 2001 — one of the Luxembourg Moselle's pioneers of biodynamic viticulture, with Riesling, Pinot Gris and crémant tastings.

dish: Crémant 'Héritage du Moulin'; terraced Riesling & Auxerrois
w: A restored old mill housing the cellars in the picture-book wine village of Ehnen, praised in the Guide Hachette des Vins for its terraced-vineyard Rieslings and crémant 'Héritage du Moulin'.

dish: single-origin espresso from a 1928 Grand-Rue roastery
w: A roastery on the capital's main shopping street since 1928 and the first in Luxembourg to offer Fairtrade coffee — a heritage house now folded into the city's specialty-coffee trail.

dish: specialty filter coffee & brunch bowls
address: 11 Place du Théâtre, L-2613 Luxembourg (Ville Haute), Luxembourg
w: A specialty café on Place du Théâtre in the Ville Haute pouring beans from French roaster Mokxa — filter coffee and brunch bowls, a fixture of Luxembourg City's third-wave scene.

dish: homemade cakes & light bites in a 200-year-old cinema
w: A 200-year-old building in medieval Vianden turned art gallery, cinema, music club and café — selected drinks, snacks and homemade desserts beneath the castle, the town's most characterful pit-stop.

dish: flat white / specialty espresso
w: A Limpertsberg specialty café open since summer 2022 on avenue Pasteur that quickly won over the capital's coffee crowd — a focused third-wave espresso bar off the tourist track.

dish: house-roasted single-origin specialty coffee
w: A specialty roaster in Belval (Esch-sur-Alzette) known for careful single-origin brews — the south's third-wave coffee anchor beside the old blast furnaces and the university.
